Today, there are updates on The next era of Marvel Digital Comics Webtoons, November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast, and Marvel Doomsday Ticket Opening Date in India.

## The next era of Marvel Digital Comics Webtoons
Marvel and WEBTOON have officially launched a new digital comics subscription app, replacing Marvel Unlimited. The new app, launched by Naver Webtoon, features 35,000 titles and marks the official start of Marvel's Webtoon era. The launch was noted to have some limitations, including not being available on all tablets and lacking screencap functionality. This development is expected to significantly change the landscape of digital comics.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Akvan is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm and is projected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast on November 20th, with wind gusts potentially reaching 145 kilometers per hour. While the cyclone is heading towards Andhra Pradesh, Chennai and its surrounding areas are forecast to experience light rains on November 17th, with an Orange Alert issued for November 18th and 19th due to the cyclone's proximity.

## Marvel Doomsday Ticket Opening Date in India
Advance bookings for 'Avengers: Doomsday' have officially opened in India, with an overwhelming response from fans. The film has already seen significant sales, with over 50,000 tickets sold in a record rush and day one advance bookings crossing ten crore rupees gross, selling over one lakh national-chain tickets in just 19 hours. Due to high demand, theaters in India are gearing up for round-the-clock screenings, including 3:25 AM shows. Ticket prices for the movie in India start at 420 rupees, with premium seats going up to 1,500 rupees.
